text:
maria: Deploybot just flagged a canary p95 latency spike in us-west-2, auto-rollback kicked — canary traffic is now reverting. Anyone seeing related alerts?
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] 2024-09-12 09:46:29 UTC: CANARY_LATENCY > THRESHOLD (p95=312ms, threshold=250ms). Auto-rollback initiated: candidate v3.6.0 -> stable v3.5.2. Rolling back canary slice 10% -> 0% over 2m window.
kai: :eyes: I'm seeing increased CPU on infer-srv-7 and a huge number of kv-cache evictions coincident with the spike.
sre_oncall: grabbing logs now, will check KVMetrics and model shard locality. If kv evictions are root cause we may prefer a small runtime flag revert vs full rollback.
jules: quick question — we have a dedicated EU customer pinned to v3.6.0. Does deploybot auto-rollback affect dedicated pools?
maria: Dedicated pools are excluded from deploybot auto-rollback (they're pinned). This is hosted canary only. Confirming.
amanda: CS heads-up: ticket queue shows 3 customers reporting slower response times; looks like hosted only. Preparing standby communications if rollback persists.
kai: logs snippet: 
```
2024-09-12T09:45:58Z infer-srv-7 kvcache: eviction_count=423
2024-09-12T09:46:01Z model_load: quant_patch applied
```
sre_oncall: kvcache eviction spikes align with the canary traffic pattern and the quantization patch application. Recommend either: A) allow rollback to complete (fast, lowest user risk), or B) suppress rollback, apply runtime flag to disable quant_patch and re-run canary (smaller blast radius).
maria: Two high-level options: 1) let deploybot finish auto-rollback to v3.5.2 now (fast, conservative), or 2) manual hold + hotfix to disable quant_patch then re-promote v3.6.0. Thoughts?
jules: If it's a runtime flag causing evictions, hotfix is lower risk and preserves rollout momentum. But need to make sure pinned dedicated customers stay unaffected.
kai: I propose we abort the rollback, apply hotfix to canary, run a 30m smoke, then re-promote. That avoids blipping dedicated pools and reduces churn.
sre_oncall: Commands to abort/pause if we go manual: 
```
rollback-runner abort --thread 1723456789
deploybot pause --deployment canary --reason "investigating kvcache evictions"
```
maria: I'll take owner to coordinate hotfix. @deploybot can you pause further automated rollbacks for tag v3.6.0 until we clear?
deploybot: [SYSTEM] Auto-rollback suppression activated by user request for tag v3.6.0; suppression expires in 60m.
amanda: Good. CS will send a short note to affected customers: "We're investigating increased latency for hosted inference; we are pausing automatic rollout while we apply a hotfix. ETA 45-90m." Will post draft here.
jules: I'll prepare the cherrypick PR and release note blurb: 
- Title: fix(runtime): disable quant patch causing kvcache evictions
- PR: #4321 cherrypick -> v3.6.0-hotfix
maria: Oncall, run smoke after hotfix: 3x heavy text gen, 1x large embedding; post results.
sre_oncall: starting patch rollout to canary (1 node). Monitoring KV hitrate and p95.
kai: Dashboard updates: kv-hit 82% -> 95% after patch, p95 dropped to ~210ms.
maria: :tada: Hotfix looks good in canary. Recommend we keep canary pinned for 30m then unpause deploybot to continue rollout.
deploybot: [SYSTEM] Auto-rollback suppression expired for tag v3.6.0; resuming standard rollout policy.
maria: Ok restart the rollout but keep manual 30m hold on final promotion. I'll pin a manual note in the release registry: v3.6.0 -> v3.6.0-hotfix. @amanda please update CS message to customers with resolution and planned postmortem.
amanda: Drafting now, will include ETA and apology.
ops_bot: Reminder: if a manual full rollback had completed, we'd need to run release_notes_unwind and product_comms steps. Since we suppressed and applied hotfix, mark incident state as "mitigated, hotfix applied".
jules: PR merged to registry and changelog updated with canary observation note.
maria: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: kai (root cause analysis), jules (release notes/changelog), amanda (customer comms), maria (rollout ops). I'll open the postmortem doc and link it here.
sre_oncall: Smoke tests passed end-to-end. Leaving canary hold for 30m then final push.
maria: Thread closed after 30m hold with no regressions observed. :white_check_mark:
